Here the item map IS the official publication, and it is the same table this project's item data comes from. Three things guard it. First, tools/preflight.py re-derives every multiple-choice key by a second, unrelated code path -- a naive plain-reading-order re-read of the PDF with no geometry at all -- and compares; across the twelve tests that is 282 keys with no disagreement. Second, the NYCPS 'NYS Exam IM Alignment' sheets in sources/nycps/ independently agree with our standard for 256 of 273 items on the 2023-2025 tests, and where they differ ours is the more precise reading.
